structure_patterns.name: Neighborhood and latent collaborative signals
structure_patterns.structural_change: Use interaction neighborhoods or learned user and item ID factors as an additional retrieval signal; neighborhood methods aggregate observed co-interactions, while factor methods compress them into vectors.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A popularity or content-only baseline misses repeat-interest items on a fixed user cohort, and interaction density is sufficient to estimate neighbors or factors.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Time-ordered user-item interactions, catalog membership, interaction-density and cold-user/item slices, and a fixed retrieval candidate universe.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Hold the interaction split, candidate universe, negative protocol, and top-K budget fixed; compare with popularity/content baselines and inspect sparse-user and cold-item slices.
structure_patterns.reject_if: The gain disappears on the held-out temporal split, is only popularity concentration, or sparse users/items degrade beyond the declared guardrail.

structure_patterns.name: Item context and side-information embeddings
structure_patterns.structural_change: Learn item representations from local co-occurrence contexts; optionally blend item ID and side-attribute embeddings to represent less-observed items.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: ID-only item representations underperform on low-history items while temporally valid item contexts or side attributes have measurable coverage.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Pre-decision ordered item contexts, item catalog, side-attribute availability when used, and coverage metrics by item age and interaction count.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep the same context pairs and retrieval protocol; compare against ID-only vectors and a shuffled-context control, then isolate the side-attribute blend.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Cold-item gains are absent, shuffled contexts perform similarly, or side attributes are unavailable at serving time.

structure_patterns.name: Pairwise feature interactions
structure_patterns.structural_change: Add second-order field interactions through factorized products, pooled product vectors, field-pair weights, or attention and gating over pairs.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A linear or plain MLP baseline leaves repeatable validation errors on supported pairs of pre-decision fields, such as user segment by offer attribute.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Typed field schema, pre-decision availability, support counts for candidate field pairs, and slice-level residuals on a held-out split.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Add one pair-interaction mechanism to the same inputs and prediction head; keep embedding width, training budget, split, and metric fixed, then ablate the interaction branch.
structure_patterns.reject_if: No held-out improvement over the ablation, gains come from rare or leaked pairs, or latency exceeds the stated budget.

structure_patterns.name: Explicit and attention-based higher-order crosses
structure_patterns.structural_change: Add configured wide crosses, bounded-degree cross layers, matrix or expert cross layers, vector-wise crossing, or field attention alongside the prediction backbone.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Pairwise interactions still leave stable residual patterns across three or more supported fields, or the existing wide crosses require excessive manual enumeration.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Typed and serving-available fields, repeatable higher-order slice effects, adequate joint support, and a parameter and inference-cost budget.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Compare one cross mechanism against the same backbone with the cross branch disabled and against a pairwise baseline, using identical fields and split.
structure_patterns.reject_if: The cross branch does not improve held-out slices, depends on unsupported combinations, or exceeds the agreed cost budget.

structure_patterns.name: Indexable user and item representations
structure_patterns.structural_change: Encode user context and catalog items into separately computable vectors so dot product or cosine similarity can retrieve candidates from an index.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: The current candidate generator has low recall at a fixed candidate count, and user and item features support separately computed representations.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Item catalog and index update cadence, user/item features available before retrieval, labeled interactions, and a fixed candidate and negative-sampling protocol.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep the catalog, top-K, index freshness, training examples, and retrieval metric fixed; compare with a simpler linear tower or collaborative retriever.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Recall or coverage fails to improve at fixed K, index freshness breaks feature consistency, or serving cost breaches the budget.

structure_patterns.name: Sampled-item logit correction
structure_patterns.structural_change: Adjust in-batch item logits using the item's logged sampling weight while retaining the retrieval tower and candidate representation.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: In-batch training overweights frequently sampled items and held-out recall or calibration varies systematically by item popularity.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Known sampling weights from the actual training sampler, item-frequency slices, and an unchanged evaluation candidate universe.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Train corrected and uncorrected logits with the same tower, batches, sampler, and evaluation protocol; inspect recall and calibration by item-frequency slice.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Sampling weights are unknown or inconsistent with the sampler, or corrected logits provide no held-out improvement.

structure_patterns.name: Target-aware history for ranking
structure_patterns.structural_change: Condition attention over past behavior on the candidate item; optionally model interest evolution or aggregate within and across sessions before target activation.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: The same user receives different outcomes for candidate types and a pooled-history baseline has persistent target-specific residuals.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Timestamped histories strictly before each candidate decision, candidate features, valid session boundaries when used, and adequate sequence coverage.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use the same prior events and candidate features; replace target-aware aggregation with masked mean pooling, then ablate evolution or session components separately.
structure_patterns.reject_if: No held-out gain over pooling, post-decision events enter histories, or sequence length and latency exceed the fixed budget.

structure_patterns.name: Order-sensitive sequence retrieval
structure_patterns.structural_change: Encode the ordered history or current session with causal attention, recurrent states, or short- and long-term fusion to predict the next item.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Next-item errors vary with recency or within-session order, and an order-agnostic history representation leaves stable temporal residuals.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Event timestamps, session boundaries where applicable, pre-decision sequence construction, a fixed next-item candidate universe, and negative-sampling details.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep the histories, temporal split, sampler, and candidate universe fixed; compare with an order-agnostic pooled-history retriever at the same top-K budget.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Order adds no held-out gain, future events leak into prefixes, or sequence inference cost exceeds the budget.

structure_patterns.name: Multiple user-interest vectors
structure_patterns.structural_change: Represent one user's history with multiple interest vectors and select the target-relevant interest during training or retrieval.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A single user vector misses distinct, supported interest clusters within the same users while total top-K is held fixed.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Sufficient per-user behavioral diversity, stable interest-cluster slices, item embeddings, and a deduplicated fixed-K candidate protocol.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Compare one and multiple interest vectors with the same encoder inputs, item catalog, total retrieved K, and training sampler.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Interest vectors collapse, gains disappear after deduplication at fixed K, or sparse users regress beyond guardrails.

structure_patterns.name: Shared and task-specific experts
structure_patterns.structural_change: Share a representation across observed tasks, then separate task heads or use gated shared and task-specific experts; scenario-conditioned gates are possible when the scenario is known.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Related task metrics diverge across training runs, a single shared trunk harms at least one task, or independent models waste signal on sparse task labels.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Aligned task labels and missingness rules, task priorities and guardrails, sample counts per task, and scenario labels if scenario-conditioned gating is tested.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Hold inputs and task losses fixed; compare independent heads, a shared bottom, and one gated-expert variant at matched training and parameter budgets.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Primary-task improvement is offset by an unacceptable task regression, gates collapse, or label missingness is mistaken for negative outcomes.

structure_patterns.name: Ordered outcome transfer
structure_patterns.structural_change: Transfer information along an ordered outcome chain through a probability product constraint or attention between earlier and later task representations.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Later-stage outcomes are sparse and direct training has unstable validation behavior, while earlier-stage labels are observed at substantially higher coverage.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: A genuine temporal and semantic outcome order, impression-level labels, valid masking for later outcomes, and calibration metrics at each stage.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Compare with independent or unconstrained task heads on the same impression split; evaluate the later-stage outcome and calibration while monitoring earlier stages.
structure_patterns.reject_if: The outcomes are not truly ordered, the constraint miscalibrates joint probability, or later-stage gains disappear on low-coverage slices.

structure_patterns.name: Scenario-conditioned experts and normalization
structure_patterns.structural_change: Condition normalization, expert gates, or layer activations on a known scenario while retaining shared parameters across scenarios.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A global model has repeatable, materially different residuals across scenarios, and separate per-scenario models lack enough data or are costly to serve.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Scenario identity available before inference, per-scenario counts and held-out metrics, and a stable definition of scenario across training and serving.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use identical fields and split; compare a global shared model, separate scenario heads, and one conditioned variant with fixed aggregate and per-scenario guardrails.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Small scenarios regress, scenario identity drifts or leaks outcomes, or the conditioning yields no held-out gain over a shared model.

structure_patterns.name: Low-rank adaptation and soft segmentation
structure_patterns.structural_change: Adapt a shared transformation through compact context-generated factors or softly partition examples among simple local response functions.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Response patterns vary across supported contexts, but a global model underfits and fully separate high-capacity models overfit or exceed memory limits.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Pre-decision context fields, support and response metrics by context, and an explicit parameter, memory, and latency budget.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Hold features and split fixed; compare the global model, explicit per-segment baselines, and one compact adaptive or soft-segment variant at matched cost.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Soft regions or generated factors collapse, held-out context gains vanish, or complexity exceeds the declared budget.

structure_patterns.name: Slate-aware reranking and position response
structure_patterns.structural_change: Score candidates jointly with position and neighboring-item context, or model per-position response and continuation before selecting an order.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Item-level scores are stable but observed slate outcomes vary by position or neighboring items, and independent score sorting leaves a measurable slate-level gap.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Logged candidate sets and displayed positions, pre-decision slate features, exposure and position-bias assumptions, and a valid slate-level evaluation protocol.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Reorder the same fixed candidate set under the same placement constraints; compare with independent-score sorting on slate-level outcomes and position slices.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Position or exposure effects cannot be identified from logs, the gain is only an offline bias artifact, or item-level guardrails fail.

structure_patterns.name: Neighborhood message passing
structure_patterns.structural_change: Mean neighbor aggregation followed by concatenation, projection, activation and L2 normalization.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A measured residual or supported slice suggests this component addresses a specific limitation of the current model.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: node_features, sampled_neighbors, neighbor_mask, pre-decision provenance and matched evaluation data.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep the backbone, input availability, labels, split and evaluation budget fixed; change this component only and report its cost.
structure_patterns.reject_if: The required inputs or assumptions are unsupported, held-out gain is absent, or a task guardrail regresses.

structure_patterns.required_evidence: adjacency_rows, graph_edges, pre-decision provenance and matched evaluation data.

structure_patterns.name: Bias factorization

structure_patterns.structural_change: Independent image-query and ID-query attention channels pool the same behavior-image history.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A measured residual or supported slice suggests this component addresses a specific limitation of the current model.

structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep the backbone, input availability, labels, split and evaluation budget fixed; change this component only and report its cost.

structure_patterns.name: Teacher student distillation
structure_patterns.structural_change: Detached Bernoulli KL from joint click/long-read teacher probability to a two-tower student; joint teacher BCE helper.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A measured residual or supported slice suggests this component addresses a specific limitation of the current model.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: teacher_logits, student_logits, impression_click_and_read_labels, pre-decision provenance and matched evaluation data.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep the backbone, input availability, labels, split and evaluation budget fixed; change this component only and report its cost.
structure_patterns.reject_if: The required inputs or assumptions are unsupported, held-out gain is absent, or a task guardrail regresses.

structure_patterns.name: Token subspace mixing
structure_patterns.structural_change: Feature tokens are partitioned into heads, rewired across tokens, and processed by independent per-token GELU FFNs with post-residual LayerNorm.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A supported residual suggests information is lost by the current interaction or aggregation path.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Field tokens with stable positions and a declared width/token budget.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use identical tensors, head and training budget; ablate the added mechanism and measure quality and cost separately.
structure_patterns.reject_if: No held-out improvement, invalid feature timing/masks, or unacceptable parameter, latency or memory cost.

structure_patterns.name: State-conditioned history gating and pooling
structure_patterns.structural_change: Condition history gates or independent pooling channels on available candidate or field representations.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A supported residual suggests information is lost by the current interaction or aggregation path.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Time-safe domain histories, valid-position masks and the declared conditioning tensors.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use identical tensors, head and training budget; ablate the added mechanism and measure quality and cost separately.
structure_patterns.reject_if: No held-out improvement, invalid feature timing/masks, or unacceptable parameter, latency or memory cost.

structure_patterns.name: Cross-layer explicit interaction readout
structure_patterns.structural_change: LayerNormed user/candidate states form full cross-bus dot products at every layer; accumulated cross-bus and optional pre-residual domain dots are separately normalized and returned to the host head.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A supported residual suggests information is lost by the current interaction or aggregation path.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Layer-aligned user/item states; optional pre-residual domain dots with explicit query/readout alignment.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Use identical tensors, head and training budget; ablate the added mechanism and measure quality and cost separately.
structure_patterns.reject_if: No held-out improvement, invalid feature timing/masks, or unacceptable parameter, latency or memory cost.

structure_patterns.name: User-query item-context field interaction
structure_patterns.structural_change: Apply separate within-side self-attention, then gated user-query/item-key-value attention; return both token sets for host composition.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Observed residuals suggest user-item field relations are lost before the host head, and both field-token sides are available.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Declared user/item token semantics, availability masks and a field-only control. Event histories are not required.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Keep fields, head and training budget fixed; ablate self and cross stages separately, and measure quality and cost against a simpler field mixer.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Improvement depends on padding or future fields, vanishes on held-out data, or exceeds the host cost budget.

structure_patterns.name: History-initialized context-aware query generation
structure_patterns.structural_change: Retrieve per-domain history evidence from item tokens, append it to field context, and use history-initialized mean/max probes to query that context.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: A measured ranking bottleneck concerns how field context selects behavior evidence or constructs queries for an existing host sequence block.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Time-safe domain histories and masks, declared item/context or user/item tokens, and a downstream host consumer for returned representations.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Hold data, head and training budget fixed; compare retrieval with mean pooling and query generation with a projection-only control, then ablate each composed stage.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Probes collapse without useful task signal, gains require leakage or padded content, or memory/latency cost outweighs reproducible held-out gains.

structure_patterns.name: MGDIN-inspired initial-affinity progressive edge masks
structure_patterns.structural_change: Rank directed field-token edges once by initial affinity, then allow nondecreasing edge counts across learned attention and FFN layers. The original ranking is reused throughout the forward pass.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Defined field/group token axis, valid masks, observed unsupported/noisy early interactions or persistent pair residuals, and fixed parameter and edge-compute budgets.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Defined field/group token axis, valid masks, observed unsupported/noisy early interactions or persistent pair residuals, and fixed parameter and edge-compute budgets.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Using the same weights, dimensions and inputs, compare full-edge, fixed-sparse and progressive schedules. Keep downstream head, data split and optimizer fixed; ablate the schedule separately from width or depth.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Reject a proposed improvement if its controlled task metric does not support it, input/time/gradient provenance is invalid, or guardrails fail. An observation-only probe is not a performance improvement.

structure_patterns.name: SIF-inspired per-event contextual representation, original continuous adapter
structure_patterns.structural_change: Project aligned event item and context features into a common space and combine them at each historical event, preserving event order and sanitizing padding.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Existing aligned per-event attributes and history masks with pre-prediction availability. Confirm the context already exists and is unused before requesting new dataset fields.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Existing aligned per-event attributes and history masks with pre-prediction availability. Confirm the context already exists and is unused before requesting new dataset fields.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Compare item-only and item-plus-context encodings with the same history length, downstream encoder/head and training budget. Include context-shuffle or context-ablation controls.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Reject a proposed improvement if its controlled task metric does not support it, input/time/gradient provenance is invalid, or guardrails fail. An observation-only probe is not a performance improvement.

structure_patterns.name: CCFormer-inspired independently normalized user/history/target relations
structure_patterns.structural_change: Use independent learned Q/K/V/output projections and separate softmax normalization for user-to-history, target-to-history and target-to-user attention.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Explicit user, ordered history and target token meanings and masks; evidence that joint normalization or candidate-independent history pooling loses useful relational signals.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Explicit user, ordered history and target token meanings and masks; evidence that joint normalization or candidate-independent history pooling loses useful relational signals.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Hold encoders, head and training budget fixed; compare separate relation normalization with joint pooling and ablate one relation at a time. Keep target candidates independent.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Reject a proposed improvement if its controlled task metric does not support it, input/time/gradient provenance is invalid, or guardrails fail. An observation-only probe is not a performance improvement.

structure_patterns.name: Discount preference inside the existing response backbone
structure_patterns.structural_change: Add a discount-conditioned representation and an optional supervised discount head to the existing interest representation.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Observed response residuals vary across supported historical discount/price/category or promotion slices and pre-decision purchase and calendar inputs are available.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Input timing/ratio definitions, history coverage, aligned purchase attributes, a fixed backbone control and realized-label coverage for any auxiliary objective.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Preserve the host objective and splits. Isolate the branch from auxiliary supervision, then ablate a component whose failure hypothesis is supported by observed evidence; record capacity and compute.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Missing histories are fabricated, current-order discounts leak, response gains are labeled uplift without causal evaluation, or held-out quality/resource guardrails fail.

structure_patterns.name: Coordinate-dependent interaction
structure_patterns.structural_change: At each layer, add x0*(W*x+b)*sigmoid(G*x) to the current hidden state, retaining the initial feature vector.; Generate an unbounded nonlinear coordinate mask from original features, multiply current hidden state, then project, optionally normalize and ReLU.; Apply two learned temperature-softmax field weight vectors, each shared across embedding coordinates, to form cross/deep inputs.; Normalize low-rank Gram features X*(X^T*P), transform them into tokens with a ReLU MLP, concatenate linear field compression and add a projected residual.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Context or field-slice residuals suggest selective multiplicative processing. First compare with the existing local cross/MLP control.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Declared typed tensor/feature contracts, current candidate source, host-observed baseline residual or training evidence, fixed task/dataset version, and measured cost where relevant.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Change one mechanism at a time; preserve accumulated compatible components and use the same split, budget and objective unless that objective is the declared intervention. Context or field-slice residuals suggest selective multiplicative processing. First compare with the existing local cross/MLP control.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Required inputs are absent or post-decision; tensors or masks are incompatible; gradients do not reach intended parameters; improvement fails its held-out criterion or disappears under the stated simpler control.

structure_patterns.name: Stream exchange and fusion
structure_patterns.structural_change: Scale input features by twice sigmoid of a context-conditioned two-layer ReLU gate, independently instantiated per stream.; Fuse two representations with affine contributions and separate bilinear parameter tensors for matching contiguous head partitions.; Communicate cross/deep intermediate states through product, sum, projected concatenation or two independently parameterized attention gates.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Two existing streams show complementary supported residuals. Test mid-layer exchange or fusion while preserving both input branches.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Declared typed tensor/feature contracts, current candidate source, host-observed baseline residual or training evidence, fixed task/dataset version, and measured cost where relevant.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Change one mechanism at a time; preserve accumulated compatible components and use the same split, budget and objective unless that objective is the declared intervention. Two existing streams show complementary supported residuals. Test mid-layer exchange or fusion while preserving both input branches.

structure_patterns.name: Field-specific pair parameters
structure_patterns.structural_change: Compute lexicographic i<j field-pair scores using a distinct matrix e_i^T*M_ij*e_j or vector-weighted product for each pair.; Combine weighted within-group FM vectors with weighted products between pooled semantic groups.; Dot each field i embedded for partner j with field j embedded for partner i, keeping the i<j pair axis.; Concatenate diagonal copy-operation embeddings with off-diagonal field-aware pair dot values.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Known field identities and supported pair/group errors justify distinct partner parameters. Compare shared-bank and pair-specific encodings under a memory ceiling.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Declared typed tensor/feature contracts, current candidate source, host-observed baseline residual or training evidence, fixed task/dataset version, and measured cost where relevant.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Change one mechanism at a time; preserve accumulated compatible components and use the same split, budget and objective unless that objective is the declared intervention. Known field identities and supported pair/group errors justify distinct partner parameters. Compare shared-bank and pair-specific encodings under a memory ceiling.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Required inputs are absent or post-decision; tensors or masks are incompatible; gradients do not reach intended parameters; improvement fails its held-out criterion or disappears under the stated simpler control.

structure_patterns.name: Higher-order and factorized products
structure_patterns.structural_change: Split an affine projection into a,b and emit a+a*b or concat(a,a*b), preserving factorized multiplicative interactions.; Split field coordinates into heads, multiply them by multiple ReLU-projected rows, sum rows, restore field-coordinate order and add the residual.; Dynamic programming computes exact elementary symmetric products over distinct fields for one selected order.; Power sums and Newton identities produce a concatenated readout of all elementary symmetric interaction orders 1..K.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: Lower-order controls underfit an interaction hypothesis on current fields. Increase order or factorization locally before enlarging the entire backbone.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Declared typed tensor/feature contracts, current candidate source, host-observed baseline residual or training evidence, fixed task/dataset version, and measured cost where relevant.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Change one mechanism at a time; preserve accumulated compatible components and use the same split, budget and objective unless that objective is the declared intervention. Lower-order controls underfit an interaction hypothesis on current fields. Increase order or factorization locally before enlarging the entire backbone.

structure_patterns.name: Alternative interaction algebra
structure_patterns.structural_change: Real FFT pair multiplication followed by inverse FFT yields circular convolution, or correlation by conjugating the left spectrum.; Lift each embedding to the unit hyperboloid time component and return LorentzFM triangle interaction values for field pairs.; Learn field-axis interaction orders in log(abs(x)) space and exponentiate their bounded linear combinations.; Apply shared learned field orders to log magnitudes and phases, reconstruct real/imaginary outputs and add a shared implicit ReLU projection.; Fuse full initial-field/current-subspace outer products with learned alpha, multiply by output-specific channel matrices, and contract a learned channel vector.
structure_patterns.when_to_try: An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
structure_patterns.required_evidence: Declared typed tensor/feature contracts, current candidate source, host-observed baseline residual or training evidence, fixed task/dataset version, and measured cost where relevant.
structure_patterns.controlled_comparison: Change one mechanism at a time; preserve accumulated compatible components and use the same split, budget and objective unless that objective is the declared intervention. An explicit product or geometric hypothesis remains unexplained by simple pairwise controls. Compare the new algebra with the same representation width and numerical scale.
structure_patterns.reject_if: Required inputs are absent or post-decision; tensors or masks are incompatible; gradients do not reach intended parameters; improvement fails its held-out criterion or disappears under the stated simpler control.

structure_patterns.name: Candidate and history state refinement
structure_patterns.structural_change: Append the candidate token to history, add learned positions, then apply bidirectional multihead self-attention and residual feed-forward refinement. Expose transformed history and candidate readout.; Causally refine events, compute a second head-split self-attention, expand each head separately, then use independent target/position-conditioned DIN-style attentions to form multiple interests.; Context/position-conditioned scores form causal prefix user states; their final valid state matches the target by a dot product. structure_patterns.name: Selection and refinement of long histories
structure_patterns.structural_change: Learned target/history dot scores create an unnormalized coarse weighted sum, including negative contributions; valid-only top-K retrieval feeds a separate learned target-attention fine readout.; Fixed checkpointed random-hyperplane signs yield Hamming distance from target; retrieve nearest K valid history events and apply learned target attention.; Sum history embeddings whose full random-hyperplane bit code equals the target code independently for each hash; average the hash-specific sums.; Each learned query/key head chooses its own top-K history events; exactly those scores normalize corresponding value heads, then concatenated head outputs are projected.; Target, masked recent-history mean and global-history mean independently query fixed LSH top-K; original indices are restored to temporal order. Each selected stream receives masked complex block-channel FFT refinement, pooled interests and final target attention.
